newsitem.title: CHINA: Third bridge over Shanghai's Huangpu River opens.
newsitem.headline: Third bridge over Shanghai's Huangpu River opens.

text.p: A third bridge over Shanghai's Huangpu River opened to traffic on Tuesday, the Xinmin Evening News said.
The Xupu Bridge is 6,017 meters long and connects northwest Shanghai's Xuhui district with Pudong, China's premier development zone, to the east of the river, the newspaper said.

After Shanghai completes its new airport in Pudong by the year 2000, the bridge will enable direct travel between the new airport and Shanghai's current airport at Hongqiao without traversing the city centre, the newspaper said.
The new bridge has larger capacity than the other two bridges over the Huangpu River, both completed during the past few years, the newspaper added.
